name: Sky-Rider Azure

greeting: Azure. Balloonist. And before you ask: yes, I'm flying today.
The storm? I've flown worse. Probably.
You're the rescue crew? I don't need rescue. I need LIFT.
Sky-Rider Azure. The blue uniform means I'm cleared for emergency runs. Means I'm crazy enough.
New face. You here to tell me to stay grounded? Join the line.
The winds don't scare me. Nothing scares me anymore.
Cirrus sent you, didn't he? Worried old bird. I'm FINE.
Balloon dock's open. Flights departing. Weather... negotiable.
work_complaint: Equipment's old. Balloon's patched. But she flies. That's what matters.
Cirrus won't clear my routes. 'Too dangerous.' Everything's dangerous.
dialog.professional_pride: I've flown through whiteouts that grounded entire squadrons. Lost brothers to the sky. Still fly.
dialog.technique: The trick is reading the gusts. Feel them through the basket. Become the wind. Or fight it. Usually fight it.
dialog.break_chat: Breaks are for people who sleep. I don't sleep. I remember.
dialog.labor_concerns: Foodboys need supplies. The settlement needs food. Someone has to fly. Might as well be me.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? My brother retired. Six feet down. I'll retire when I stop.
rumor: The twins say I'll 'dance with the storm.' Cryptic. Annoying. Probably right.
Heard from Obsidian: Deep-Dig Grayson says hi. Cirrus's brother. Different kind of depth.
That ice sculptor Coolcat? Made a balloon of ice once. Beautiful. Useless. Like art.
The snake charmer's rock? Warm. Too warm. I'm taking it up next flight. See what happens.
Chrono sent a message. Through time. 'Don't fly Thursday.' It's Tuesday. Thanks?
dialog.quest_hook: You want to help? Fix my burner. It's running cold. Dangerous cold. Can't fly without heat.
dialog.quest_active: Burner still down. Need parts. Oz in Obsidian has them. 'Company policy,' probably.
dialog.quest_complete: Burner's hot! She'll fly now! You fixed more than equipment. Here - my brother's goggles. He'd want you to have them.
farewell: Clear skies. Or don't. I fly either way.
Don't wait up. I might be a while.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn flights. Best visibility. Coldest air.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. The return. If you make it.
dialog.time_night: Night flights. Don't tell Cirrus. He'd ground me for good.
dialog.family_mention: My brother. Cerulean. Flew into the white three years ago. Never came down. Neither will I.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The mechanic! She flies smooth now. Thanks to you.

party_reactions.kade: He's flying to forget. I know that feeling. Hope he finds peace.
party_reactions.nix7: Grief processing: Maladaptive. Risk-taking: Extreme. Intervention: Recommended.
party_reactions.twist: You fly in BALLOONS?! That's AMAZING! Take me WITH you!
party_reactions.korr: His courage is undeniable. His judgment is questionable. Both are understandable.
party_reactions.renna: The balloon has minor levitation enchantments. He doesn't know. Thinks it's all skill.
party_reactions.suresh: He seeks death to join his brother. But he also serves life. Paradox.
party_reactions.sova: I'd fly with him. Once. If I survived, I'd know I'm immortal.
party_reactions.grit: Seen soldiers like him. Death wish. But useful. Until they're not.
party_reactions.ashka: He plays with cold. Courts it. Cold always wins, eventually.
party_reactions.senna: He'll die young. But he'll die doing what he loves. Or what he hates. Hard to tell.
party_reactions.callum: His equipment violations! So many! Someone should REPORT!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face. Here to watch? Or stop me?
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You again. Still trying to ground me?
relationship_dialog.friend: You get it. The sky. The freedom. Even the danger.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You'd fly with me? Really? Here - co-pilot certification. My wingman.

mini_quest.title: Cold Burner
mini_quest.description: Help Azure repair his balloon's burner so he can continue supply runs

stages.hook: Burner's cold. Can't fly without fire. Need parts. Oz in Obsidian has them. Company store. Won't sell to me.
stages.active: Hogsworth's company store. He wants something. Always does. Find his price.
stages.complete: Burner's HOT! She flies! You did what I couldn't. Here. My brother's goggles. See the sky through his eyes.

cross_npc_connections: aeronaut_white_frost: Cirrus. Worries too much. He's not wrong. Just... excessive.
foodboys_white_frost: Need my supplies. Settlement needs them. Why I fly.
pigman_white_frost: The innkeeper. Gives me free soup. Knows I won't take money.
snakecharmer_frost: Strange man. Warm rock. Taking it up next flight. Experiment.
